drhp.business: GVK Power & Infrastructure Limited is a listed holding company that earlier operated across Energy, Airports, Transportation and Urban Infrastructure verticals through subsidiaries, step-down subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates. risks.note: With the closure of the Airports business and a bleak outlook in Energy and Transportation, and no ability to raise funds from lenders or institutions, management states it is unable to diversify into any other area of business.
The Company now has only one revenue-generating asset, the 330 MW Alaknanda Hydro Power Company Limited, concentrating group cash flows in a single project.
Management flags shortage of fuel, high AT&C losses, a differential tariff structure and delays in tariff revisions as contributors to the power deficit situation affecting the sector.
risks.risk: Energy sector fuel and tariff risk

risks.note: Management flags delays and disruptions from traffic congestion, weather, accidents, strikes, customs clearance and regulatory changes, along with labor shortage, cargo loss/theft, incorrect documentation and inadequate insurance.

GVK Energy Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, was admitted into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process on a petition by IDBI Bank for default of corporate guarantee obligations extended for loans to a fellow group company, GVK Power (Goindwal Sahib) Limited.

Management states that infrastructure companies across India, including GVK, face challenging loan repayments due to minimal or delayed revenue flows, leading to classification as Non-Performing Assets by lenders.

The Company's cautionary statement notes that domestic and international economic conditions, government regulations, tax regimes and other statutes affecting the electricity industry could cause actual results to differ materially from management's objectives and projections.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- With the closure of the Airports business and a bleak outlook in Energy and Transportation, and no ability to raise funds from lenders or institutions, management states it is unable to diversify into any other area of business.
- The Company now has only one revenue-generating asset, the 330 MW Alaknanda Hydro Power Company Limited, concentrating group cash flows in a single project.
- Management flags shortage of fuel, high AT&C losses, a differential tariff structure and delays in tariff revisions as contributors to the power deficit situation affecting the sector.
- Management flags delays and disruptions from traffic congestion, weather, accidents, strikes, customs clearance and regulatory changes, along with labor shortage, cargo loss/theft, incorrect documentation and inadequate insurance.
- GVK Energy Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, was admitted into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process on a petition by IDBI Bank for default of corporate guarantee obligations extended for loans to a fellow group company, GVK Power (Goindwal Sahib) Limited.
- Management states that infrastructure companies across India, including GVK, face challenging loan repayments due to minimal or delayed revenue flows, leading to classification as Non-Performing Assets by lenders.
- The Company's cautionary statement notes that domestic and international economic conditions, government regulations, tax regimes and other statutes affecting the electricity industry could cause actual results to differ materially from management's objectives and projections.
